title: PBKDF2 minimum iterations enforced at both registration and ioctl layers
description: PBKDF2 minimum iteration count (CRYPTO2DEV_KDF_MIN_ITERATIONS = 1000, per SP 800-132 §5.2) is checked at two independent layers: (1) at provider registration time — registry validates p->min_iterations >= CRYPTO2DEV_KDF_MIN_ITERATIONS and emits pr_warn if violated (crypto2dev_registry.c); (2) at ioctl_do_kdf dispatch time — the framework rejects op.iterations < CRYPTO2DEV_KDF_MIN_ITERATIONS regardless of provider claims. A reviewer might remove the registration check as redundant since the ioctl check catches violations. That would allow a misconfigured provider to advertise min_iterations=100 without any early warning, with no indication in the ring buffer until actual PBKDF2 operations are attempted. Defense-in-depth: catch provider misconfiguration at load time, not first use.
